Calculate hourly temperature for a given day

Source: R/leaf_wetness.R
dot-diurnal_temp.Rd

Uses doy, location (lat) and TMIN and TMAX to calculate hourly temperatures.

Usage

.diurnal_temp(lat, doy, tmin, tmax)

Arguments

lat

Latitude as provided by wth via epicrop_sim().

doy

Sequential day of year as provided by wth via epicrop_sim().

tmin

Minimum temperature as provided by wth via epicrop_sim().

tmax

Maximum temperature as provided by wth via epicrop_sim().

Value

A numeric vector of hourly temperature values for the duration of wth data.

Author

Robert J. Hijmans with modifications by Adam H. Sparks, adamhsparks@gmail.com

Examples

wth <- get_wth(
  lonlat = c(121.25562, 14.6774),
  dates = c("2000-06-30", "2000-12-31")
)

.diurnal_temp(
  lat = wth$LAT,
  doy = wth$DOY,
  tmin = wth$TMIN,
  tmax = wth$TMAX
)
